unbound_gate: ACTUAL_INPUTS_READY=False. The exact inline source digest/argv and readiness/metadata guards run before any controller filesystem operation, directory creation or Git child. After the one source-carrier transfer is independently qualified, only its exact actual metadata and readiness flag may be filled in a new reviewed binding delta.

input_custody.directory_handles: BASE, fixed carrier root, incoming and carrier control are held open. Every child is resolved relative to its held parent fd with O_NOFOLLOW; begin/end checks compare each held inode to its named entry.
input_custody.file_handles: Two source inputs and the raw transport receipt stay open across the import. Exact lossless version/whole SHA/mode/owner/link-count and held/name identity are checked before and after.

output_custody.fresh_control: ROOT.mkdir creates only a new owned 0700 root; no existing controller or failure root is reused.
output_custody.fresh_source: SOURCE.mkdir creates the sibling source exclusively before Git. Its directory fd is registered under deferred cancellation, checked against the BASE-relative name before clone and after import, and closed in finally.
output_custody.source_if_failure: Partial new control/source directories are retained. There is no automatic delete, retry, replacement or import replay.
output_custody.durability: All tracked source bytes, Git files and directories are fsynced by the original materialization helper; BASE is also fsynced after creating the sibling source and after final receipt publication.

import_sequence: Read exact ready input metadata and full raw receipts from held descriptors; verify actual exporter and source-carrier completion.
Verify strict bundle v2 header, zero prerequisites and sole canonical HEAD; recheck all inputs.
Create fresh controls and sibling source; store exact inline controller and intent.
Run original file-only owned Git clone --no-checkout --no-hardlinks into the exclusively created source directory, then bundle verify/list-heads.
Detach checkout canonical commit and remove the clone's local origin; prove sole parent, root commit, exact history count and full strict fsck.
Require Git index equals full canonical tree and verify every one of the 3911 materialized blob bytes/mode; no sparse source, symlink, hardlink or alternates.
Freeze independent .git/clean state, recheck all held source inputs and source directory name, then close every descriptor and process under original final guards.
Publish original result and terminal; only authoritative exit0 plus terminal deadline and all-owned closure qualifies this source import.
changed_definition: verify_receipts: validates exact standalone export and completed source carrier instead of native-build artifacts
cleanup_scope: Original owned Git lifecycle remains byte-identical, including original timeout handling and final TERM/KILL. New fd registration defers cancellation until ownership is recorded. This does not claim a new universal one-signal cleanup protocol.

validation.first_directory_component_failure: Synthetic harness omitted UID; original NameError kept, then only synthetic globals were corrected. Candidate unchanged.

non_goals: No binary/seed execution, compiler, HTTP, provider, old B01 replay, production change or source-ref mutation.
No old desktop repository, object alternates, incremental bundle prerequisite or network Git fetch is used.
No import qualification is transferred from the old X230 receiver or from the new source-carrier inert result.
No existing source or product artifact is rewritten.
